description: Displays the incoming value as a widget in the mobile app. The block is read-only: it drives no register and has no outputs. The widget title comes from the block instance name.

ui.name: Unit
ui.description: Unit shown next to the value, for example °C, %, kWh. Leave empty to show the number alone.

ui.name: Decimals
ui.description: Number of decimal places the widget rounds the value to.
